task.title: Luxury Real Estate Presentation for 12518 W Sunset Blvd

user_message.content:
Create a beautiful, professional property packet/presentation for 12518 W Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90049. This should be a stunning visual presentation suitable for a luxury real estate context.

Extract the attached tar.gz file first: tar xzf cma_packet.tar.gz

Inside the cma/ folder you'll find:
- CMA_12518_Sunset_Blvd.md (full property data and comparables)
- Multiple .jpg photos of the property (exterior_front.jpg, exterior_twilight.jpg, pool_rear.jpg, exterior_side.jpg, and others)

Create a single-file HTML presentation (dark luxury aesthetic, gold accents, elegant typography) that includes:

1. COVER PAGE — dramatic hero image with property address overlay
2. PROPERTY OVERVIEW — key stats (4 bed, 4.5 bath, 4,500 sqft, $5,799,000), description highlights
3. PHOTO GALLERY — showcase all available property photos in an elegant grid/slideshow
4. KEY FEATURES — the luxury amenities (pool, rooftop deck, smart home, Thermador kitchen, ADU, etc.)
5. COMPARABLE SALES — clean table or cards showing the 6 comps with sold prices, sqft, $/sqft
6. MARKET ANALYSIS — the valuation summary, price range, market context
7. LOCATION — Brentwood neighborhood highlights, nearby schools (all 9-10 rated), proximity to ocean and Beverly Hills

Design requirements:
- Dark/black background with gold (#C9A96E or similar) accents and white text
- Luxury real estate aesthetic — think Engel & Volkers or Sotheby's style
- Embed the property images as base64 so the HTML is fully self-contained
- Make it print-friendly (looks good printed as well as on screen)
- Responsive layout
- Professional typography (use Google Fonts like Playfair Display for headings, Inter or similar for body)

Save the final file as /home/ubuntu/property_packet_12518_sunset.html
